concerns.text: The plan uses `statsmodels.stats.power.FTestPower` (a between‑subjects F‑test power calculator) with effect size f = 0.25 to justify sample size, but the experimental design is a within‑subject Latin‑Square (each participant sees each snippet under exactly one condition). Between‑subjects power formulas do not account for the reduced error variance and correlation structure inherent in repeated‑measures designs, so the computed required N may be inaccurate and could lead to an under‑powered study.
